career_ladder.note: HSSC Common Eligibility Test (CET) Group C serves as the mandatory qualifying gateway for all Group C ministerial, executive, and technical posts across Haryana Government departments, statutory boards, and universities. Promotions follow respective departmental service rules under the Haryana Civil Services framework.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Group C posts in Haryana operates through a two-tier mechanism: the Common Eligibility Test (CET Group C) screening examination followed by post-group specific Mains written/skill examinations for shortlisted candidates.

stages.stage_name: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group C Screening)
stages.source_label: HSSC CET Group C Policy Notification No. 42/119/2019-5GS-I & Examination Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Awareness, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English, Hindi, and Computer Fundamentals (75% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.95 deducted if fifth bubble left unshaded
papers.qualifying_threshold: 50% marks for General Category (47.5 marks out of 95), 40% for Reserved Categories

papers.paper_name: Haryana General Knowledge — History, Civics, Geography, Literature, Environment, and Culture of Haryana (25% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.95 deducted if fifth bubble left unshaded
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate qualifying cutoff with general section

stages.stage_name: Group C Category-Specific Mains Written Examination
stages.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 03/2023 & Syllabus for Group C Posts (Groups 1 to 63)

papers.paper_name: Post-Relevant Domain & Subject Knowledge (70% weightage: e.g. Commerce/Engineering/Land Revenue/Secretariat Administration)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; fifth bubble mandatory

papers.paper_name: General Awareness, Reasoning, Computer Literacy & Haryana History/Culture (30% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; fifth bubble mandatory

financial_package.note: Remuneration for Group C posts in Haryana spans Functional Pay Levels FPL-2 (₹19,900) for Clerks up to FPL-6 (₹35,400) for specialized posts, governed by Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, Finance Department, Government of Haryana
financial_package.estimate_note: Lower boundary calculated on entry Level 2 basic pay (₹19,900) with 58% DA (₹11,542), HRA (8% to 24% by city tier), and standard deductions. Upper boundary calculated on entry Level 6 basic pay (₹35,400) with 58% DA and Class X/Y city HRA.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) as sanctioned by Finance Department Haryana
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by City Grade (X/Y/Z: 24%/16%/8%)
Medical allowance / reimbursement under Haryana Government Medical Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) once in a block of four years
New Pension Scheme (NPS) with state government matching contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: HSSC CET Group C represents one of the largest competitive recruitment examinations in Northern India, regulating appointment across all Group C cadres in Haryana.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 11 (calculated: CET qualified candidates ÷ Group C vacancies)

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 35 (calculated: registered applicants ÷ notified vacancies)
